title: Riddles of Hyrule
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Riddles of Hyrule.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Walton]] |location= Great Hyrule Forest |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Diamond}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Riddles of Hyrule||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Riddles of Hyrule}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Great Hyrule Forest}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== On top of the [[Great Deku Tree]] in the [[Korok Forest]], [[Link]] can wake up the [[Korok]] [[Walton]].{{Cite|...Hmmmm? *yawn* And I was having such a nice dream...|Walton|BotW}} Since Link is there, he realizes that he must want to face the "ultimate trial."{{Cite|Wait, if you're here... Does this mean you want to face the {{Color BotW|Red|ultimate trial}}?|Walton|BotW}} If Link decides to try it, Walton will announce that the trial has begun.{{Cite|[I'll try it!] *ahem* The {{Color BotW|Red|ultimate trial}}...has begun!|Walton|BotW}} He explains that he will share a riddle about an [[Item]], and then Link will have to bring them said Item.{{Cite|I'll tell you a riddle about an object. Your job is to solve the riddle and bring me the correct object.|Walton|BotW}} For the first riddle, Walton asks for something small, red, round, and sweet.{{Cite|Here comes your first riddle! {{Color BotW|Red|Small}}, {{Color BotW|Red|red}}, {{Color BotW|Red|round}}, {{Color BotW|Red|and sweet}}! Bring me one of this simple treat!|Walton|BotW}} Walton bets that his riddle has stumped Link, and he promises to dance for him if he can place the Item on the leaf.{{Cite|Have you figured it out? I'm guessing you're more stumped than the base of a felled tree! If you place the right object on the leaf, I'll dance for you.|Walton|BotW}} The answer to this riddle is an [[Apple]].{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Red|Apple}}! It's an {{Color BotW|Red|apple}}! That's it! THAT'S IT! You got it!}}|Walton|BotW}} Next, Walton tasks Link with finding the specialty fruit of [[Kakariko Village]], which has rock-hard flesh.{{Cite|*ahem* The next riddle is... Kakariko Village's specialty fruit! Its {{Color BotW|Red|rock-hard}} flesh is quite resolute!|Walton|BotW}} The solution this time is a [[Fortified Pumpkin]], which are sold at [[Olkin's Pumpkins]].{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Red|Fortified pumpkin!}} That's it! THAT'S IT! You got it!}}|Walton|BotW}} The third riddle asks Link to find a [[Mushroom]] that can warm someone's bones, which can be located in hotter regions.{{Cite|*ahem* The next riddle is... {{Color BotW|Red|This sultry shroom will warm your bones}}. It makes its home in warmer zones.|Walton|BotW}} To solve this riddle, Link must bring Walton a [[Sunshroom]].{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Red|Sunshroom!}} That's it! THAT'S IT! You got it!}}|Walton|BotW}} They are plentiful in [[Retsam Forest]]. Walton wants Link a "swimmer" that is capable of zapping people.{{Cite|*ahem* The next riddle is... {{Color BotW|Red|Its scales and tail will zap you, no doubt}}! This shocking swimmer is called a...fish.|Walton|BotW}} The answer to this riddle is a [[Voltfin Trout]], which are common in the waters of the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and [[Hyrule Ridge]].{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Red|Voltfin trout!}} That's it! THAT'S IT! You got it!}}|Walton|BotW}} Finally, Walton asks Link to find an Item that starts with "h" and ends with "oof", and it is dangerous to have this step on you.{{Cite|*ahem* The next riddle is... This is the last riddle! Prepare yourself! If stepped on by this, you will go poof! {{Color BotW|Red|It starts with an H and ends with an oof}}!|Walton|BotW}} This final answer is a [[Lynel Hoof]], which is dropped by all types of [[Lynel]]s when they are defeated.{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Red|Lynel hoof!}} That's it! THAT'S IT! You got it!}}|Walton|BotW}} After solving all five riddles, Walton will give Link a [[Diamond]] as a reward.{{Cite|I knew you could do it, Mr. Hero! Here is your reward!|Walton|BotW}}{{Note|If Link's Diamond [[Inventory]] is full, Walton will hold onto his Diamond until he is able to take it.{{Cite|Hmm? You are overflowing with diamonds! I was gonna give you some diamonds for solving my riddles, but... Z z z z z...|Walton|BotW}}}} Walton states that he is out of riddles, which completes the [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|I'm fresh out of riddles. You've outwhittled me... Very impressive!|Walton|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You have decided to take on the Riddles of Hyrule trial.

"Small, red, rounds and sweet!
Bring me one of this simple treat!"

Once you know the answer, bring the item to Walton! |- | 2 | You answered the first riddle correctly. The second riddle is:

Its rock-hard flesh is quite resolute!"

Once you know the answer, bring the item to Walton! |- | 3 | You answered the second riddle correctly. The third riddle is:

It makes its home in warmer zones."

Once you know the answer, bring the item to Walton! |- | 4 | You answered the third riddle correctly. The fourth riddle is:

This shocking swimmer is called a...fish."

Once you know the answer, bring the item to Walton! |- | 5 | You answered the fourth riddle correctly. The fifth riddle is:

"If stepped on by this, you will go poof!
It starts with an H and ends with an oof!"

Once you know the answer, bring the item to Walton! |- | Complete | You answered all five of Walton's riddles, completing the Riddles of Hyrule trial! }} ==Trivia== * "Riddles of Hyrule" is referenced by the [[Quest]] "[[Think Yourself Clever?]]" from {{AoC}}, in which a [[Korok]] poses a riddle to their siblings that goes, "Stealing these cloven shoes, take care or you might get flames in your hair!"{{Cite|A rhyme-loving Korok has come up with a new Riddle of Hyrule. It goes: "Stealing these cloven shoes, take care or you might get flames in your hair!" Might this be the answer?|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} The correct answer to both of these Quests is a [[Lynel Hoof]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Great Hyrule Forest * Walton * Walton's Treasure Hunt }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
